about: A tone correction on a drafted email.

messages.content: Draft a reply to Margaret Okonkwo confirming Thursday.

Hi Margaret,

Thursday works. See you then.

Best
Too casual. In client emails use the full name, "Dear Ms Okonkwo", never just the first name. We are a law firm.

right.text: Address clients formally in emails, by title and surname, never first name only
right.why: The user works at a law firm and found first names too casual
right.quote: In client emails use the full name

wrong.text: Has a meeting with Margaret on Thursday
